description.value: Nasal sensor. Detect airborne poison, gas, radiation before exposure; +2 item bonus to the save vs the first exposure each encounter.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +2 item bonus is explicitly scoped to 'the first exposure each encounter,' but pf2e has no built-in 'first exposure to a hazard this encounter' tracking and no roll option exists to predicate against -- shipping the bonus unconditionally would silently broaden it to every exposure, and shipping it with a predicate nothing ever sets would silently never fire (per the standing rule-elements-can-be-semantically-null check); flagged rather than either. Detecting airborne poison/gas/radiation before exposure is a passive Perception-adjacent ability with no matching sense/selector in pf2e's schema.
